Niektoré veci som pridávala neskôr len kvôli exportu obrázkov, niektoré sa vykresľujú normálne v kóde/do html.

## Načítanie dát
V "spolu_export" sú spojené dáta z databázy: LokalitaID,	SegmentID,	KodPralesovejLokality,	BiotopID,	Percento,	NazovBiotopu,	Typ,	LokalitaNazov,	OrografickeCelky aj s priradeným typom konkrétneho biotopu v každom zázname (listnatý/ihličnatý).

V "feature_vectors_s_hektarmi" sú vypočítané features aj s vytiahnutou rozlohou z kml.

"Biotopy_nazvy" sú len priradené názvy k tým kódom.

```{r load-data}
info     <- read_csv("C:/Users/Maria/Desktop/dilinovka/databaza/spolu_export.csv")
features <- read_csv("C:/Users/Maria/Desktop/dilinovka/databaza/feature_vectors_s_hektarmi.csv")
biotopy  <- read_csv("C:/Users/Maria/Desktop/dilinovka/databaza/biotopy_nazvy.csv")

features <- features |> select(-contains(c("_min","_max")))

features <- features |> select(-contains("DTM"))
```

## Čistenie feature vektorov

Niektoré segmenty sú tam viac ráz, lebo sa prekrývajú v tiffe-tie idú preč. (prekrývajú akože že jeden je divný tvar a boundng box je široký a to pokryje celý ďalší prales tak ten menší je aj sám za seba vyrátaný, ale aj v tom väčšom, lebo som to robila ako "čo je vnútri to sa ráta")

```{r dedup-features}
n_before <- nrow(features)
features <- features |> distinct()
cat("Duplicate rows removed:", n_before - nrow(features), "\n")
```

## Príprava a join

Spojenie dohromady tých info features + biotopy + názvy biotopov.

```{r prepare-join}
info     <- info     |> rename(Segment = SegmentID)
info     <- info     |> mutate(Segment = as.character(Segment))
features <- features |> mutate(Segment = as.character(Segment))

#niektore sementy su tamviackrat lebo maju viac biotopov a viac casti, tak im pridelim cislo
features <- features |>
  group_by(Segment) |>
  mutate(subpart_id = row_number()) |>
  ungroup()

# spojenie
combined <- features |>
  left_join(info, by = "Segment", relationship = "many-to-many")


bad_units <- combined |>
  group_by(Segment, subpart_id) |>
  summarise(total_percent = sum(Percento, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(total_percent > 100)

combined <- combined |>
  anti_join(bad_units, by = c("Segment", "subpart_id"))

iba_informacia<- combined|>select(ForestName,Segment,KodPrales,HodnotSeg,Hectares,Percento,NazovBiotopu,subpart_id,Poznamka)
```

## Chýbajúce segmenty

Niektoré segmenty nemáme biotopy— najmä tie z 2. mapovania, lavínové žľaby, mladiny, výseky. Tu sa len zisťujú, mažú sa ďalej.

```{r missing-segments}
missing <- features |>
  filter(!Segment %in% info$Segment) 

cat("Chýbajú info o segmentoch:", nrow(missing), "\n")
if (nrow(missing) > 0) print(missing$Segment)
```

## Odstránenie NA

Väčšina dôvodov: 2. mapovací cyklus, lavínové žľaby, sute, skaly (napr. Bielovodská dolina). Proste nemajú v tej tabulke info aj keď sú označené ako prales

```{r remove-na-1}
n_before <- nrow(combined)
combined <- combined |> drop_na()
cat("Rows with NA removed:", n_before - nrow(combined), "\n")
```
## Jeden riadok na segment — výpočet typu

Ak má segment viac biotopov, ale všetky rovnakého typu, zachováme typ.
Ak má mix typov 1 a 2, priradíme typ 3 (zmiešané).

```{r dominantne typy}

combined_unique <- combined |>
  distinct(Segment, BiotopID, Percento, Typ, .keep_all = TRUE)

type_dominance <- combined_unique |>
  group_by(Segment, Typ) |>
  summarise(total_percent = sum(Percento, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

problem_segments <- type_dominance |>
  group_by(Segment) |>
  filter(total_percent == max(total_percent)) |>
  filter(n() > 1)

dominant_type <- type_dominance |>
  group_by(Segment) |>
  slice_max(total_percent, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup()

dominant_clean <- dominant_type |>
  filter(total_percent >= 90)

combined <- combined |>
  left_join(
    dominant_clean |> rename(Typ_dominant = Typ),
    by = "Segment"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Typ_dominant)) |>   
  mutate(Typ = Typ_dominant) |>     
  select(-Typ_dominant)|>
  group_by(Segment, subpart_id) |>
  slice_max(Percento, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup()
```

## Odstranenie malych

Od oka 0,35ha je hranica

```{r odstranit male}
#tak odoka som vybrala 0,35ha
combined<-combined |> filter(Hectares>0.35)
```

## Necháme iba ihličnaté a listnaté
```{r binarna uprava}
combined_binary <- combined |>
  filter(Typ %in% c("listnaty", "ihlicnaty")) |>
  droplevels()
```

```{r clean-data}
data_clean <- combined_binary |>
  select(where(is.numeric)) |>
  select(-any_of(c("subpart_id", "LokalitaID", "Datum", "MapovatelHlavnyID",
                   "zapisID_kb", "Percento", "Hectares", "Area", "Perimeter","Typ","total_percent")))

forest_names <- combined_binary$ForestName
forest_types <- combined_binary$Typ
forest_biotopes <- combined_binary$BiotopID

```


## nearZeroVar — rozšírený filter variancie

Toto robilo niečo keď tam bolo to DTM, ale keď už tam nie je tak to nemazalo nič. Je to tu ale aj tak pre istotu.

```{r nzv}
nzv_idx <- nearZeroVar(data_clean, saveMetrics = FALSE)

if(length(nzv_idx) > 0) {
  pca_input <- data_clean[, -nzv_idx]
  cat("Odstránené NZV stĺpce:", names(data_clean)[nzv_idx], "\n")
} else {
  pca_input <- data_clean
  cat("Žiadne stĺpce s nulovou varianciou sa nenašli.\n")
}

cat("Zostatok stĺpcov pre ďalší krok:", ncol(pca_input), "\n")
```

## Korelácia — filter

Thershold je 0.95

```{r correlation-filter}
cor_matrix   <- cor(pca_input, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
high_cor_idx <- findCorrelation(cor_matrix, cutoff = 0.95, verbose = TRUE)

print(names(pca_input)[high_cor_idx])
pca_input <- pca_input[, -high_cor_idx]
cat("Zostatok stĺpcov:", ncol(pca_input), "\n")
```

## VIF filter

"Variance Inflation Factor (VIF) is a statistical measure used to quantify how much the variance of an estimated regression coefficient increases due to multicollinearity among predictor variables."
Iteračný proces, postupne to maže.

```{r vif}

vif_result <- vifstep(as.data.frame(pca_input), th = 10)
print(vif_result)

pca_input <- pca_input[, names(pca_input) %in% vif_result@results$Variables]
cat("Zostatok stĺpcov:", ncol(pca_input), "\n")
```

## PCA
```{r pca}
fit <- prcomp(pca_input, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
summary(fit)

pve <- fit$sdev^2 / sum(fit$sdev^2)

scree <- data.frame(PC = 1:15, PVE = pve[1:15])

ggplot(scree, aes(x = PC, y = PVE)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, color = "#2C3E50") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "#E74C3C") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:15) +
  labs(title = "Scree Plot", x = "PC", y = "PVE") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

cumulative <- data.frame(
  PC         = 1:length(pve),
  Cumulative = cumsum(pve)
)

ggplot(cumulative, aes(x = PC, y = Cumulative)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgreen") +
  labs(title = "Cumulative Variance Explained",
       x     = "Principal Component",
       y     = "Cumulative Proportion") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)


```

pca_scores$ForestName <- forest_names

## Loadingy
```{r hlavne komponenty}
get_top_contributors <- function(pca_fit, pc_num, n = 10) {
  loadings <- pca_fit$rotation[, pc_num]
  top_vars <- sort(abs(loadings), decreasing = TRUE)[1:n]
  data.frame(
    Variable = names(top_vars),
    Loading = loadings[names(top_vars)],
    PC = paste0("PC", pc_num)
  )
}

top_pc1 <- get_top_contributors(fit, 1)
top_pc2 <- get_top_contributors(fit, 2)



rbind(top_pc1, top_pc2)

fviz_contrib(fit, choice = "var", axes = 1, top = 20, fill = "lightgray", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("Najvýznamnejšie premenné pre PC1") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))

fviz_contrib(fit, choice = "var", axes = 2, top = 20, fill = "lightgray", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("Najvýznamnejšie premenné pre PC2") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))
```

## LDA
```{r lda}

#lda_fit <- lda(x = scale(pca_input), grouping = forest_types)
lda_fit <- lda(x = pca_scores[, 1:7], grouping = forest_types)

lda_scores <- as.data.frame(predict(lda_fit)$x)
lda_scores$Type <- forest_types
lda_scores$ForestName <- forest_names
lda_scores$SegmentID  <- combined_binary$Segment
lda_scores$Poznamka <-combined_binary$Poznamka
lda_scores$Percento_dom <-combined_binary$Percento
lda_scores$Percento_type<-combined_binary$total_percent
lda_scores$size <- combined_binary$Hectares


ggplot(lda_scores, aes(x = LD1, fill = Type)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("ihlicnaty" = "#1B5E20", "listnaty" = "#E65100")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "LDA — rozdelenie typov lesa", x = "LD1", y = "Hustota")

predictions <- predict(lda_fit)$class
lda_scores$PredictedType <- predictions
wrong_samples <- lda_scores[lda_scores$Type != lda_scores$PredictedType, ]
print(wrong_samples[, c("ForestName", "Type", "PredictedType", "LD1","SegmentID","Poznamka","Percento_dom","Percento_type")])
```

```{r lda s hranicou}
vars <- paste0("PC", 1:7)

X <- as.matrix(pca_scores[, vars])
# X= riadky sú segmenty, stlpce su ich hodnoty PC1 az 7
g <- droplevels(as.factor(forest_types)) #to len ulozi zaradom ci je listnaty/ihlicnaty seg
lev <- levels(g)#ia ake su triedy, my mame 2

# priemery tried
mu1 <- colMeans(X[g == lev[1], , drop = FALSE])
mu2 <- colMeans(X[g == lev[2], , drop = FALSE])

# spoločná kovariančná matica tried
S_pooled <- matrix(0, nrow = length(vars), ncol = length(vars),
                   dimnames = list(vars, vars))

for (cl in lev) {
  Xg <- X[g == cl, , drop = FALSE]
  S_pooled <- S_pooled + (nrow(Xg) - 1) * cov(Xg)
}

S_pooled <- S_pooled / (nrow(X) - length(lev))

# inverzia kovariančnej matice
Sinv <- solve(S_pooled)

# priory z LDA modelu
pi1 <- lda_fit$prior[lev[1]]
pi2 <- lda_fit$prior[lev[2]]

# parametre diskriminačných funkcií delta_1 a delta_2
a1 <- as.vector(Sinv %*% mu1)
a2 <- as.vector(Sinv %*% mu2)

names(a1) <- vars
names(a2) <- vars

b1 <- as.numeric(-0.5 * t(mu1) %*% Sinv %*% mu1 + log(pi1))
b2 <- as.numeric(-0.5 * t(mu2) %*% Sinv %*% mu2 + log(pi2))

# hranica: delta_1 = delta_2
# teda: (a1 - a2)^T x + (b1 - b2) = 0

A <- a1 - a2
B <- b1 - b2

xvar <- "PC1"
yvar <- "PC6"
zvar <- "PC5"

other <- setdiff(vars, c(xvar, yvar, zvar))

fixed_other <- colMeans(X[, other, drop = FALSE])

axis_x <- seq(min(X[, xvar]), max(X[, xvar]), length.out = 40)
axis_y <- seq(min(X[, yvar]), max(X[, yvar]), length.out = 40)

const_other <- sum(A[other] * fixed_other)

surface_z <- outer(axis_x, axis_y, function(x, y) {
  -(A[xvar] * x + A[yvar] * y + const_other + B) / A[zvar]
})

p_3d <-plot_ly() %>%
  add_markers(
    data = pca_scores,
    x = ~PC1,
    y = ~PC6,
    z = ~PC5,
    color = ~as.factor(forest_types),
    colors = c("#f8766d", "#00bfc4"),
    marker = list(
    size = 4,
    sizemode = "diameter",
    opacity = 1),
    text = ~paste0("Forest: ", ForestName, "<br>ID: ", SegmentID),
    hoverinfo = "text"
  ) %>%
  add_surface(
    x = ~axis_x,
    y = ~axis_y,
    z = ~t(surface_z),
    opacity = 0.75,
    showscale = FALSE,
    colorscale = list(c(0, 1), c("#708090", "#708090"))
  ) %>%
  layout(
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = xvar),
      yaxis = list(title = yvar),
      zaxis = list(title = zvar, range = c(-6, 5))
    )
  )


p_3d



xvar_2d <- "PC1"
yvar_2d <- "PC6"

# všetky komponenty, ktoré v 2D grafe nezobrazujeme
# sem teraz patrí aj PC5
other_2d <- setdiff(vars, c(xvar_2d, yvar_2d))

# fixujeme ich na priemerné hodnoty
fixed_other_2d <- colMeans(X[, other_2d, drop = FALSE])

# ich príspevok do rovnice hranice
const_other_2d <- sum(A[other_2d] * fixed_other_2d)

# rovnica hranice:
# A_PC1 * PC1 + A_PC6 * PC6 + const_other_2d + B = 0
# vyjadríme PC6 ako y:
# PC6 = -(A_PC1 * PC1 + const_other_2d + B) / A_PC6

slope_2d <- -A[xvar_2d] / A[yvar_2d]
intercept_2d <- -(const_other_2d + B) / A[yvar_2d]

p_biplot <- fviz_pca_biplot(fit,
                axes          = c(1, 6),
                geom.ind      = "point",
                habillage     = pca_scores$Type, 
                pointsize     = 2.5,             
                addEllipses   = TRUE,
                ellipse.level = 0.95,
                col.var       = "black",
                alpha.var     = 0.6,      
                select.var    = list(contrib = 10),
                labelsize     = 6,               
                repel         = TRUE,            
                legend.title  = "Typ lesa",
                axes.linetype = "blank") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  labs(
    x = "PC1 (28,1 %)",
    y = "PC6 (5 %)",
    title = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text       = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = c(0.88, 0.15),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin      = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )


p_biplot_with_line <- p_biplot + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey65", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey65", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = intercept_2d, 
    slope = slope_2d, 
    color = "black", 
    linewidth = 1.2
  )

# 3. Zobrazenie a uloženie
print(p_biplot_with_line)
ggsave("biplot_PC1_PC6_LDA.png", plot = p_biplot_with_line, width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

```{r, cv}
set.seed(123)

df <- data.frame(
  forest_types = as.factor(forest_types),
  pca_input
)

# LOOCV
lda_loocv <- train(
  forest_types ~ .,
  data = df,
  method = "lda",
  preProcess = c("center", "scale", "pca"),
  trControl = trainControl(method = "LOOCV", savePredictions = TRUE),preProcOptions = list(thresh = 0.90)
)

cat("\n=== LOOCV ===\n")
print(lda_loocv)
confusionMatrix(lda_loocv$pred$pred, lda_loocv$pred$obs)

# k-fold CV
lda_kfold <- train(
  forest_types ~ .,
  data = df,
  method = "lda",
  preProcess = c("center", "scale", "pca"),
  trControl = trainControl(method = "cv", savePredictions = TRUE, number = 5),
  preProcOptions = list(thresh = 0.90)
)

cat("\n=== 5-FOLD CV ===\n")
print(lda_kfold)
confusionMatrix(lda_kfold$pred$pred, lda_kfold$pred$obs)
```
